info.name: Car Service & Repair Booking System API
info.description: Complete, production-ready Postman collection for the Car Service & Repair Booking System API. Covers all 16 modules, 100+ endpoints, file uploads, automated ID/token chaining, role-based authorization, and an end-to-end testing workflow.

item.name: 02. Authentication
item.description: User authentication, JWT token refresh, profile management, and OTP password recovery

request.description: Logs in as Super Admin. Automatically saves accessToken, refreshToken, and adminUserId to collection variables.
Public registration for customers. Automatically assigns default Customer role. Automatically saves customerId and customerEmail.
Logs in with the registered customer credentials. Saves customerAccessToken and customerRefreshToken.
Uses a valid refresh token to get a new 15-minute access token without re-entering credentials.
Returns profile details of the currently authenticated user (excluding password).
Updates the authenticated user's first name, last name, and phone number.
Changes the authenticated user's password. Requires current password.
Initiates password reset. In non-production mode, returns generated 6-digit OTP in response and saves to variable.
Validates the OTP and returns a 10-minute password reset token. Automatically saved to resetToken variable.
Sets a new password using the verified resetToken.
Logs out the authenticated user and invalidates the server-side refresh token.

Deletes a role by ID.
